outputs.visual_description_en: The image is a digital graphic with an orange header and white background. The header contains the text '□□ बड़ी खुशखबरी □□' (Big Good News). The main body of the text, in black, announces 'प्रधानमंत्री मुफ्त लैपटॉप योजना 2026' (PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026), stating that free laptops are being given to all students by the government. It specifies an application deadline of '15 अक्टूबर' (October 15) and instructs users to click a link to register their name. A blue URL, 'www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in', is prominently displayed. Below it, in red, is the instruction 'इसे सभी ग्रुप में फॉरवर्ड करें' (Forward this to all groups).
